newsitem.title: USA: FX Energy slips on news of plugged well.
newsitem.headline: FX Energy slips on news of plugged well.

text.p: Shares of FX Energy Inc fell more than 33 percent after the company said it had to plug its Orneta 1 well after finding water instead of natural gas or oil. Shares fell 3-3/16 to 6-7/16 in early trading.
The well was the first oil and natural gas exploratory well drilled in Poland by a western company.

The company said it is surveying two new drillsites and plans to drill two more wells this year in the Baltic concession to test two additional structures, including the Gladysze structure, covered in last year's seismic program.
The Orneta 1 is operated by Warmia Petroleum Co, a subsidiary of FX Energy, with a 50 percent working interest.
RWE-DEA, a subsidiary of RWE AG, also has a 50 percent working interest in the well.
